description: This file implements the scheduler_event_logger class, which logs various scheduler events such as PRACH, RACH indications, UE creation/reconfiguration/removal, error indications, SRS, CSI reports, BSR, HARQ ACK, CRC, MAC CEs, RLC buffer states, PHR, and slice reconfiguration. It uses fmt and logger for formatted output and handles different logging modes.

classes.name: scheduler_event_logger
classes.description: A class responsible for logging various scheduler-related events in a formatted manner, with different modes for debug and info levels.

methods.name: scheduler_event_logger
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the logger with cell index and PCI, setting the logging mode based on logger configuration.

methods.name: log_impl
methods.description: Logs the processed slot events, either in debug or info mode.

methods.name: enqueue_impl
methods.description: Overloaded methods to enqueue various event types (e.g., prach_event, rach_indication_message, ue_creation_event, etc.) into the log buffer, formatted according to event type and mode.

methods.name: separator
methods.description: Returns a separator string (', ' or ' ') based on whether the buffer has content.
